metadata.title: Cyclone Preparedness Decision Intelligence API
metadata.description: Production RESTful API for evidence-based spatial decision support and cyclone preparedness intelligence across coastal Karnataka (Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, and Uttara Kannada). Grounded in deterministic AHP criteria, Census 2011 baselines, MoHFW healthcare registries, and 4-tier operational priority allocations.
